next_action: Use an operator-approved production load window and isolated test identities/channel with agreed fixture sizes and concurrency, plus an operator SSH session or a dedicated trusted CI measurement job. Sample docker volume inspect, df/findmnt on that exact mount, private API available/reserved/snapshot metrics, and upload status throughout the load and an overlapping normal build; retain timestamps and running image SHA. decision: One subsequent build retained substantial idle headroom, but QA-08 remains open. The accessible environment cannot safely prove sustained production capacity during representative uploads.
